name: Shizzle's Flyer
summary: Shizzle asks you to bring him webbed scales from diemetradons and pterrordaxes. He needs eight of each in Marshal's Refuge.

sections.title: Scales for Shizzle
sections.body: In Marshal's Refuge, Shizzle asks you for scales from two creatures. He needs eight Webbed Diemetradon Scales and eight Webbed Pterrordax Scales. You gather both kinds for him.

faq.answer: Shizzle needs eight Webbed Diemetradon Scales and eight Webbed Pterrordax Scales.

faq.q: Who am I collecting scales for?
faq.answer: You are collecting the scales for Shizzle.

faq.q: Where is Shizzle asking for the scales?
faq.answer: Shizzle asks for the scales in Marshal's Refuge.
